selection: Use proof structure and prior reviews, not a fixed universal ranking. Register the reason before editing.
update: Reflection proposes changes; user review and a new version/session are required.

strategies.condition: A local definition has no downstream use
strategies.counterexample: Deletion may remove useful elaboration constraints

strategies.condition: A known constructor/lemma directly builds a goal currently solved by search
strategies.counterexample: Explicit evidence can increase tokens or elaboration work

strategies.condition: An existing boundary lemma matches the required intermediate fact
strategies.counterexample: Coercions and side conditions can exceed saved work

strategies.condition: The same intermediate fact is derived repeatedly
strategies.counterexample: A general helper can cost more than specialized local derivations

strategies.condition: A large definition is expanded before its structure is needed
strategies.counterexample: The subsequent tactic may need the expanded normal form

strategies.condition: Equivalent calculation/case structures offer different search spaces
strategies.counterexample: Fewer proof lines do not imply fewer heartbeats
